name: Make
shortDescription: Visual automation across apps. The pricing FAQ we fetched describes a free plan with 1,000 credits a month.
longDescription: Make is a visual automation product. A direct HTML crawl of pricing sometimes returned 403; a fetch of the official pricing FAQ did describe a Free plan with 1,000 credits per month. Paid Core, Pro, and Teams plans sit above that. We did not create an account.
pricingNotes: Credits billing unit as of Aug 27 (year not re-stated on snippet). Core/Pro/Teams paid.
freeTierNotes: Official pricing FAQ states Free plan includes 1000 credits per month (and related storage). Direct HTML crawl sometimes 403; WebFetch of pricing page succeeded.
bestFor: Teams that want a hosted builder rather than a library
smokeTestNotes: No local install attempted (SaaS/desktop/extension or install not feasible without account).
